cases.name: EVOX Production LLC v. Midjourney, Inc.
Warner Bros. Entertainment Inc. v. Midjourney, Inc.
Disney Enterprises, Inc. and Universal v. Midjourney, Inc.

profile_text.body:
Midjourney is a for-profit independent research lab founded in 2021 and headquartered in San Francisco, California. The company describes itself as exploring new mediums of thought and expanding the imaginative powers of the human species, with projects organized around themes it identifies as imagination, coordination, reflection, beauty, and human flourishing.

The company's primary tracked product is Midjourney, an AI image generation tool categorized under image and graphic design. The site does not detail the technical architecture of the tool, but notes on the product flag IP provenance as a relevant consideration.

Midjourney faces substantial legal exposure, with 175 cases logged in California and multiple active federal suits. These include EVOX Production LLC v. Midjourney, Inc. and Warner Bros. Entertainment Inc. v. Midjourney, Inc., both in the Central District of California, as well as Disney Enterprises, Inc. and Universal v. Midjourney, Inc. in the same court. Midjourney is also named in Andersen v. Stability AI Ltd., a broader copyright lawsuit pending in the Northern District of California that encompasses multiple AI image generation companies.
